name: hcapp_startDirectMessage
description: The door to a direct message (E9.F1.S19) from 'Message <name>' in any chat, or the chat bubble on a hasher list (E9.F1.S32). Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 129, @param NULL); no permission gate — the target's DM preference (HC6.DirectMessagePreference over Hasher.Preferences bits 0x4000|0x8000) and the pair's HC.HasherFriendMap rows decide. Outcome: open (already friends, target accepts anyone, or the target had already asked the caller — both rows get FriendSince and a shared ThreadId, minted if new), requested (target is friends-only and a request is now or already on file; ALSO returned when the target has blocked the caller or declined, with nothing written, so neither is revealed), refused (target accepts nobody), blocked (the caller has blocked the target). A new request returns push rowsets 2-3, which the API sends and strips.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device. Default NULL (ValidateAppAuth then refuses).

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret). Default NULL.

parameters.name: targetPublicHasherId
parameters.description: The hasher to message, by public id. Wins when both ids are given.

parameters.name: targetHasherId
parameters.description: Or the hasher's internal id, used when @targetPublicHasherId is NULL: the phone's hasher lists (RSVP, members) hold only the user sync's hasherId (E9.F1.S32, 2026-10-12). Additive; older callers unaffected.

rowsets.description: Auth failure (ValidateAppAuth) returns this detail rowset ALONE, with no envelope. The SP's own refusals return {success:0, errorCode, errorType} at index 0 then this detail at index 1: 2002 target not found / removed / self (errorType 2), 2003 unhandled (5). No debugMessage column.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Index 0 on 2002 and 2003, followed by the detail at index 1.

rowsets.name: Result

columns.name: ThreadId
columns.description: UPPER-case thread id when Outcome = 'open', else NULL. Clients lowercase on arrival.

columns.name: OtherPublicHasherId
columns.description: UPPER(CAST(Hasher.PublicHasherId AS NVARCHAR(40))) of the target.

rowsets.description: On success: the outcome and the other party.

rowsets.name: PushDetail
rowsets.description: API-only, stripped: present only when this call created a NEW request (@newRequest = 1).

rowsets.name: Recipients
rowsets.description: API-only, stripped, new request only: the target's devices with removed = 0, an FcmToken, LastLogin within 180 days and BuildNumber >= HC6.MinBuildForDmPush().

columns.name: BadgeTotal
columns.description: HC6.UserUnreadChatTotal for the icon badge; NULL on builds below HC6.MinBuildForIconBadge().

sideEffects: New request (no row either way, target friends-only): INSERT HC.HasherFriendMap (UserId = caller, Friend_UserId = target, FriendSince NULL).

Outcome 'open': MERGE WITH (HOLDLOCK) both direction rows of HC.HasherFriendMap — FriendSince = COALESCE(existing, now), ThreadId = existing thread or NEWID(), Removed = 0, updatedAt = now; inserts a missing direction row. HasherFriendMap.ThreadId / Removed come from db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-29_direct_messages.sql and updatedAt from 2026-09-29_hasher_block.sql (not in the stale table file).
Nothing is written for 'blocked', 'refused', or a silent 'requested' (pending, declined, unfriended, or blocked by the target).
Rowsets 2-3 drive a 'dmRequest' push sent by the API.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on 2002 and in the CATCH (after ROLLBACK).

codeSmells.issue: Check-then-INSERT on a UNIQUE key without UPDLOCK
codeSmells.detail: Lines 86-89 read the pair's HasherFriendMap rows OUTSIDE the transaction and with no UPDLOCK/HOLDLOCK; line 112 then INSERTs (UserId, Friend_UserId), which IX_HasherFriendMap makes unique. A double tap (or two devices) can both see no row and both insert: the second hits a duplicate-key error and lands in the CATCH as 2003 'Something went wrong'. The 'open' path is protected by MERGE WITH (HOLDLOCK); the request path is not.
Lines 131-132 and 139 return UPPER(...) ids. The app lowercases at the door, but the SP is doing deliberate work in the wrong direction (CLAUDE.md 'Ids are lowercase').

codeSmells.issue: Auth-failure rowset shape differs from the other error paths
codeSmells.detail: Lines 54-59 return the detail rowset alone; lines 76-78 and 158-160 return envelope + detail.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
